verses.text: These are the words of Agur son of Jakeh, a message. He said to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
"I am the most ignorant of people. I do not have human understanding.
I have not learned wisdom, and I do not have knowledge of the Holy One.

Who has gone up to heaven and come back down? Who has gathered the wind in his hands? Who has wrapped up the waters in his coat? Who has set all the ends of the earth in place? What is his name, and what is his son's name? Tell me, if you know!
Every word of God is perfect. He is a shield to those who go to him for safety.
Do not add to his words, or he will correct you and show that you are a liar.
LORD, I ask two things from you. Do not refuse me before I die.
Keep lies and dishonesty far from me. Do not make me poor or rich. Give me only the food I need each day.
If I have too much, I may turn away from you and say, 'Who is the LORD?' If I am poor, I may steal and bring shame on the name of my God.
Do not tell lies about a servant to his master, or he will curse you, and you will pay for it.
There are people who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers.
There are people who think they are pure, but they have not been washed clean of their filth.
There are people who are so proud. They look down on everyone.
There are people whose teeth are like swords and whose jaws are like knives. They eat up the poor from the earth and the needy from among people.
The leech has two daughters. They cry, 'Give! Give!' There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, 'Enough!':
the grave, a woman who cannot have children, land that never gets enough water, and fire that never says, 'Enough!'
Anyone who mocks their father and refuses to obey their mother will have their eyes pecked out by ravens from the valley and eaten by vultures.
There are three things too amazing for me, four that I do not understand:
the way an eagle flies in the sky, the way a snake moves on a rock, the way a ship sails on the open sea, and the way a man loves a young woman.
This is the way of an unfaithful wife: she eats, wipes her mouth, and says, 'I have done nothing wrong.'
Three things make the earth shake, four things it cannot stand:
a servant who becomes king, a fool who has plenty to eat,
a woman no one loves who gets married, and a servant girl who takes the place of her mistress.
There are four things on earth that are small but very wise:
Ants are not strong creatures, yet they store up their food in summer.
Rock badgers are not powerful creatures, yet they make their homes in the rocks.
Locusts have no king, yet they all march together in rows.
A lizard can be caught in your hand, yet it is found in kings' palaces.
There are three things that walk proudly, four that move with dignity:
the lion, the mightiest of animals, which does not turn back from anything,
the strutting rooster, the male goat, and a king with his army around him.
If you have been foolish and proud, or if you have planned evil, put your hand over your mouth!
As churning milk makes butter and twisting a nose makes it bleed, stirring up anger causes fights."
